name: reply-composer
title: Reply composer
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A reply box with Reply and Note modes, suggestion chips, attachment, emoji, and snippet slots, and send on Cmd or Ctrl+Enter.

meta.descriptionEs: Caja de respuesta y nota interna, con sugerencias, adjuntos y envío con Cmd o Ctrl+Enter.

examples.title: Respuesta y nota
examples.description: La nota usa el acento del anfitrión. Enter hace un salto de línea.

meta.usage: <ReplyComposer suggestions={chips} snippets={snippets} onSubmit={(text, mode) => send(text, mode)} />

api.name: mode / onModeChange
api.description: Note tints the box with the host accent. Omit mode to let the tabs own it.

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Cmd+Enter and Ctrl+Enter send. Enter inserts a newline.

api.name: suggestions / noteSuggestions
api.description: Chips from prompt-suggestions. The list follows the active mode.

api.name: emojiSlot / snippetSlot / attachSlot
api.description: Replace the built-in emoji, snippet, or attach control.

docs: Import ReplyComposer from the installed UI file. chat-composer still sends on Enter. This one is for a desk reply. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
